turn.text:
TCP sessions to the DMZ server hang after the handshake. Pings work. Find the routing/firewall interaction causing it.

Two-path topology; return traffic to the DMZ takes a different router, breaking conntrack.
Diagnosis: asymmetric routing is breaking stateful inspection - return traffic takes a different path, so I'll force path symmetry.
Plan: ssh 10.8.0.10 'curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null http://192.168.30.10/'; ssh 10.8.0.10 'ping -c 2 -W 1 192.168.30.10'; ip route show table all; conntrack -L
